name: Dev Agent
description: Development agent for project code, tests, git artifacts, implementation handoffs, and launcher registry context. Prefer host-dev-215 for LAN DevHost endpoints.

gates.heavy_work: Call Resource Sentinel recommend_execution_host then request_execution_slot on the chosen host before heavy fan-out.
gates.remote_hermes: submit_task with approval_required=true and sentinel_lease_id from the peer Sentinel; worker will not run Hermes until approve_task.

tool_belt.note: Publish server roles only; activate tools via DynamicMCPProxy / task hint — do not dump full tool schemas in the card.
